title: Disposition of receipts.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided for in this chapter, all fees and other moneys received by the director shall be deposited into the compliance resolution fund.
bodyHtml: [§440E-24]  Disposition of receipts.  Except as otherwise provided for in this chapter, all fees and other moneys received by the director shall be deposited into the compliance resolution fund. [L 2007, c 279, pt of §1]
